The person is a health administrative law enforcement officer, who failed to transfer cases of illegal medical practice to judicial authorities, instead using administrative penalties, thereby allowing continued illegal practice. This is abuse of power / dereliction of duty. In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime called "徇私舞弊，玩忽职守" maybe "徇私舞弊罪" (accepting bribes? no). Actually the crime is "徇私舞弊罪" under Article 397 of Criminal Law: "国家工作人员徇私舞弊，致使国家和人民利益遭受重大损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" Also there is "玩忽职守罪" (neglect of duty) under Article 397? Wait: Article 397 includes both "徇私舞弊罪" and "玩忽职守罪". The facts: He deliberately did not transfer criminal cases, for personal economic benefit. That is "徇私舞弊罪". Also possibly "滥用职权罪"? But that is for abusing authority to cause illegal acts. Here he used his authority to avoid criminal prosecution. That is "徇私舞弊罪". Also could be "玩忽职守罪" (negligence).
